The '''Frostlined Trail''' was a path that ran along the southeastern side of the [[Glarus Valley]], on the south side of the [[Fornaak River]]. It spanned most of the valley, from the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] to past the [[Elysium]].
